one_liner: FanBasis, now Commas, is a cloud ecommerce platform for selling digital products, courses, and memberships, with built-in checkout and payments.

auth.notes: The SDK guide documents a checkout session secret but does not establish how integrations authenticate to the REST API.

access.notes: Commas advertises APIs to enterprise sellers, but the available documentation does not establish whether an enterprise agreement is required or whether a new developer can obtain credentials through a free account, trial, or sandbox.

api.notes: The payments page names a REST API alongside language SDKs and a sandbox, which establishes the style. It does not describe endpoints or objects, and no API reference was readable, so breadth and a docs URL are not evidenced.

mcp.notes: Commas advertises an MCP beta for creating checkout links, issuing refunds, and retrieving business figures. No server URL, setup instructions, or enrollment requirements were verified. The pre-run MCP web search returned only generic protocol explainers, none about FanBasis or Commas.

verdict.rationale: Commas states it offers a REST API, SDKs, and a sandbox, and it advertises an official MCP beta. The available material does not establish the API's breadth or how a new developer can obtain working credentials.

evidence.quote: Generate a secure checkout session secret that will be used to initialize the payment flow. This secret ensures that only authorized requests can create checkout sessions.
APIs and embeddable components, live in days not quarters.
Built for your engineering team. REST API, SDKs for Node, Python, PHP and Ruby, a full sandbox, and 10,000+ app connections via Zapier.

problems: The previously cited SDK guide at https://demo.embedded.fanbasis.io/docs/how-it-works, and the demo host itself, could not be read by direct fetch, and no paid extract calls remained, so those earlier quotes could not be re-verified.

docs.commas.com, commasdocs.com, and www.fanbasis.io/docs did not load or did not contain an API reference. developers.fanbasis.com, docs.fanbasis.com, api.fanbasis.com, and help.fanbasis.com all redirected to the commas.com marketing homepage.
The commas.com sitemap lists only marketing, legal, and billing pages, with no developer-docs URL.
The GitHub organization FanBasis has no public repositories.
Terms and privacy policy mention the platform's APIs only in warranty and scope language, which does not establish style, breadth, or documentation.
